visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white Corgi is lying on its back in a large, open field characterized by tall green grass and scattered small white wildflowers. The dog is vigorously wriggling and rolling its torso back and forth, its four short legs kicking in the air and its mouth open in a happy expression. (2) The camera pans slightly to reveal another Corgi sitting in the background grass, wearing a blue collar. A human hand enters from the lower right of the frame and begins scratching the first Corgi's white-furred belly and hind legs, which the dog seems to enjoy as it continues to squirm. (3) The rolling Corgi eventually rights itself and stands up on all fours. It begins walking through the tall grass toward the other dog. The setting is bright with natural daylight, showing a line of trees and some distant buildings under an overcast sky.

The humorous subtitle reinforces the lighthearted nature of the clip.
